business_summary: Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the coal mining business. Its products include metallurgical coking coal, washed thermal coal, mixed coal, screened mixed coal, washed fine coal, lump coal, as well as prime coking coal, anthracite, lean coal, and bituminous coal. The company also engages in coal mining, coal beneficiation and processing, coal logistics and trade, coalbed methane development and utilization, mineral product sales, project investment, warehousing services, freight forwarding, equipment repair and leasing, property leasing, and research, information, and technical consulting services. In addition, it is involved in the research, development, production, and sale of magnetic separation equipment. The company was formerly known as Anyuan Coal Industry Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd. in September 2025. Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd.는 석탄 채굴 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 해당 제품에는 야금용 원료탄, 세척된 열탄, 혼합 석탄, 스크리닝된 혼합 석탄, 세척된 미세 석탄, 덩어리 석탄뿐만 아니라 프라임 원료탄, 무연탄, 희박 석탄 및 역청탄이 포함됩니다. 이 회사는 또한 석탄 채굴, 석탄 선광 및 가공, 석탄 물류 및 무역, 석탄층 메탄 개발 및 활용, 광물 제품 판매, 프로젝트 투자, 창고 서비스, 화물 운송, 장비 수리 및 임대, 부동산 임대, 연구, 정보 및 기술 컨설팅 서비스에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 자기분리 장비의 연구, 개발, 생산, 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Anyuan Coal Industry Group Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2025년 9월에 Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Jiangxi Tungsten Rare And Precious Equipment Co., Ltd.는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 난창에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
